jobs.title: Marketing Lead, UK
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
  
  
On the Waymo Marketing team, you will help to connect people with the magic and impact of Waymo's autonomous driving technology. Our team has the unique opportunity to not only grow Waymo's brand from the ground up, but to also build societal acceptance for autonomous driving technology for the first time in history. We build thoughtful marketing strategy, positioning, messaging and creative assets to deliver messages that matter to our audience, communicated through anything from video content, to social media interactions, to immersive physical experiences. We also shape Waymo's go-to-market initiatives, helping to transform Waymo into a thriving business with a growing user base.
  
  
In this hybrid role, you will report to the Head of Marketing.
  
  
**You Will**

* Lead Waymo's marketing strategy for the UK across brand, product positioning, and audience targeting, overseeing local marketing execution in partnership with our Global Brand, Growth, Creative, and Media teams
* With our UK marketing agenices, build resonate integrated campaigns, guiding creative, media approach, budget, and performance management
* Bring deep understanding of cultural context, competitive dynamics, and local insights to ensure tone and manner is locally resonant across UK marketing touchpoints
* Collaborate closely with Waymo PR, Product, Operations, Policy, and Regulatory teams to ensure alignment on how the product is messaged, managed, and scaled effectively for long-term success
* Over time, recruit, hire, and oversee a high-performing UK-based team
* Ensure UK learnings and best practices are well understood by US-based global leads to inform global brand decisions

**You Have**

* 15+ years in brand and/or product marketing within a B2C tech or app-based company
* Proven experience driving customer adoption of new or complex consumer products
* Deep expertise with the UK consumer landscape, especially a strong understanding of local consumer needs, culture, and creative
* Strong track record communicating and influencing at the executive-level
* Experience managing agencies, setting KPIs, and leading marketing campaigns with accountability for measurable results
* Willingness to travel at least quarterly to the San Francisco Bay Area for training and collaboration with global team

**We Prefer**

* Experience at a ride-hailing, automotive, mobility, or marketplace company
* Experience launching or scaling products in international markets, ensuring brands reinforce global brand values while resonating with local audiences
* Ability to balance long-term strategy with hands-on execution in a dynamic, early-stage or evolving market environment
* A portfolio of impactful, consumer-facing marketing campaigns targeted towards UK audiences
* Collaborative leadership skills and the ability to influence ad agencies and cross-functional teams
* Impactful communication, negotiation, and people management skills

**Travel Requirements**

* Willingness to travel globally as required. (~ 20%)

The expected base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

£158,000—£166,000 GBP

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**MARKETING MANAGER**

**Blue Note London, Covent Garden**

Contract: Full-time  | Salary: Competitive  | Reports to: Head of Marketing

**About Blue Note London**

In September 2026, Blue Note opened its first UK venue in the heart of Covent Garden. Since opening, Blue Note London has welcomed artists including Robert Glasper, Erykah Badu, Yussef Dayes, Nubya Garcia, Lianne La Havas, Common, Masego and Jamie Cullum.

With an intimate main room and an upcoming second space, B-Side, dedicated to emerging talent, Blue Note London presents an ambitious year-round programme spanning jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, RnB and beyond.

Part of Blue Note Entertainment Group, we're building on more than four decades of musical heritage while establishing a new home for live music in London.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a creative, organised and social-first Marketing Manager with a genuine passion for live music.

Reporting directly to the Head of Marketing, you'll play a key role in the day-to-day promotion of our live music programme, taking ownership of campaigns and activity across social media, email, digital advertising and our website.

A central part of the role will be leading our social media calendar, from planning and scheduling content to identifying creative opportunities around upcoming shows, artist announcements and live performances.

You'll work closely with the Head of Marketing on wider campaign strategy and priorities, while taking responsibility for delivering your own projects, managing deadlines and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen our marketing.

We're looking for someone with proven, hands-on experience in music marketing, strong creative instincts and the confidence to take initiative in a fast-moving live music environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Show Marketing & Campaigns**

* Take ownership of day-to-day campaign delivery across our live music programme, working to priorities agreed with the Head of Marketing.
* Coordinate show announcements, presales, general sales and ongoing promotional activity.
* Liaise directly with artists, agents and promoters to secure marketing assets and coordinate promotional opportunities.
* Manage assigned email marketing, paid social campaigns and targeted promotions.
* Maintain accurate event listings and promotional content across our website.
* Monitor ticket sales and campaign performance, proactively identifying opportunities for additional promotion.
* Manage campaign timelines and ensure marketing activity is delivered accurately and on schedule.

**Social Media & Content**

* Own and manage the social media calendar, taking responsibility for content planning, scheduling and publishing.
* Develop engaging, social-first content that reflects our artists, audiences and musical identity.
* Proactively identify creative opportunities around upcoming shows, announcements and wider music culture.
* Write compelling copy across social media, email, advertising and website content.
* Coordinate photography, video and creative assets with internal and external teams.
* Support content capture at live performances, including occasional evenings and weekends.
* Monitor social performance and identify opportunities to grow our audience and engagement.

**ABOUT YOU**

**Essential**

* Proven, hands-on marketing experience within live music, concerts, festivals or the wider music industry.
* A genuine passion for live music, with strong knowledge of artists, music culture and audiences.
* A social-first mindset and demonstrable experience managing social media channels and content calendars.
* Excellent copywriting skills, creative judgement and attention to detail.
* Highly organised, proactive and comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously.
* Experience using social media scheduling and content management tools.
* A self-starter who takes ownership of projects, follows through on commitments and proactively identifies opportunities.
* Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with the Head of Marketing and wider team.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Meta Ads Manager and paid social advertising.
* Experience with email marketing and CRM platforms.
* Photography, video editing or basic design skills.
* Experience working with artists, agents, promoters or live music venues.
* Familiarity with ticketing platforms and campaign reporting.

**Why Join Us?**

An opportunity to help shape the next chapter of Blue Note London, working across a diverse programme of world-class artists, emerging talent and unique live collaborations.

You'll join a small, ambitious team, working directly with the Head of Marketing while having the autonomy to lead projects, contribute ideas and make a tangible impact on the venue's growth.</Writing

jobs.description:
Communications Manager | Global Communications
  
  
Permanent | Full-time | Monday to Friday | 40-hours | Hybrid (Home | London or Bracknell)
  
  
**Help tell the story behind the people, change and innovation that bring extraordinary content to life.**
At NEP Group, we work behind the scenes of some of the world’s most exciting live productions, broadcast moments, sporting events and entertainment. Our global network spans 25 countries and more than 5,000 employees, supporting productions around the world.
  
  
Now we’re looking for an experienced
**Communications Manager**
to join our Global Communications team.
  
  
This is not a role where you’ll simply take a brief and pass it on.
  
  
You’ll shape the approach, develop the ideas, write the content and help deliver communications that make a difference.
  
  
For your first 12 months, you’ll play a key role in communicating business transformation across NEP, alongside a broad mix of employee engagement and executive communications. You’ll also contribute to priority external corporate communications, with plenty of scope for the role to evolve as our business does.
  
  
**What You’ll Get Involved In**
**Bring change to life**
Turn complex transformation and change into communications that people can understand, connect with and act on. You’ll create communication plans, messaging, FAQs, leader toolkits, presentations and other content that makes change clearer and more meaningful.
  
  
**Create employee communications people actually want to read**
Tell the stories behind our successes, strategy and progress through engaging newsletters, intranet content and business updates, adapting the message for colleagues working across different countries, roles and environments.
  
  
**Work closely with senior leaders**
Help bring town halls, leadership videos, podcasts, presentations, scripts and talking points to life, finding creative ways to make executive communications relevant and accessible to employees wherever they work.
  
  
**Shape high-profile corporate content**
Support our global communications and marketing leadership on corporate, product and commercially important communications and content.
  
  
**Own your work from idea to delivery**
You’ll manage projects end-to-end, bringing together stakeholders, creative colleagues and subject-matter experts across businesses and geographies while keeping momentum, quality and deadlines firmly on track.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
You’re an experienced communications professional who enjoys being both strategic and hands-on.
  
  
You can take a complicated subject, find the story within it and turn it into clear, compelling communications. You’re equally comfortable building a communications plan, interviewing a subject-matter expert, writing for a senior leader, coordinating a major employee update or managing multiple projects at once.
  
  
**You’ll Bring**

* 8+ years’ experience across internal, corporate, executive or related communications.
* Experience working in a complex, global or matrixed organisation with multiple time-zones.
* Hands-on experience communicating business transformation or organisational change.
* Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complexity into clear, engaging content.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to move several pieces of work forward at the same time.
* Confidence working with stakeholders at different levels, functions and locations.
* Good judgement, attention to detail and discretion when working with sensitive or evolving information.
* The independence to get things moving, combined with the instinct to collaborate when it matters.

Experience communicating with both field-based and desk-based employees, supporting senior leaders, or working in broadcast, live production, sport, entertainment or live events would be a real advantage.
  
  
**Why NEP?**
Our people help make and deliver incredible content around the world. From broadcast and live events to virtual production, our teams combine technical expertise, innovation and collaboration to help our clients bring their content to life.
  
  
Our values are Reliable, Ethical, Innovative and One Team, and they shape how we work with our clients and with each other.
  
  
For a communicator, that creates something special, NEP is a global business with fascinating stories to tell, meaningful change underway and an audience that spans countries, cultures, functions and ways of working.
  
  
If you love finding clarity in complexity, turning strategy into stories and creating communications that help people understand where a business is going, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Ready to bring great communications to life? Apply now. Closing dates for applications is Sunday 22 November 2026.**
*Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the advert early if we receive a high volume of great applications, so if you're interested, we’d love to see your application sooner rather than later!*

Our Research, Innovation and Global Engagement (RIGE) portfolio plays a vital role in supporting and promoting UCL's research, innovation and impact, working with academics, professional services colleagues and external partners.

The RIGE Communications team showcases the breadth and impact of UCL's research, developing engaging content and campaigns that raise its profile among internal and external audiences. Working closely with colleagues across UCL, the team communicates how our research addresses global challenges and makes a meaningful difference to society.

**About the role**
------------------

We are seeking a creative and experienced Communications Officer (Research) to join our RIGE Communications team. This is an exciting opportunity to help bring UCL's research stories to life, showcasing the work of our researchers and the impact of their discoveries.

Working closely with the Senior Communications Manager (Research), you will develop and deliver engaging content and multi-channel communications campaigns across websites, social media, publications, video and podcasts. You will have excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to translate complex research and scientific information into accessible, engaging content for a range of audiences. Experience of developing multi-channel digital communications, managing social media platforms and producing creative content across different formats is essential.

You will be confident using digital communications tools, including content management systems, social media scheduling platforms, Adobe Creative Suite or Canva, and analytics tools such as Google Analytics. An understanding of research or science communications, or a related field, is also important.

With strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail, you will be comfortable managing competing priorities and working collaboratively with stakeholders at all levels. Team: Bett UK
  
Role Type: Full-Time, Perm
  
  
**A bit about us**  
  
We’re Hyve - organiser of the world’s fastest-growing and most forward-thinking B2B events. As the chosen event partner to many of the world’s leading companies, our platforms play a critical role in their strategies - helping them enter new markets, accelerate growth and connect with the people who matter most.
  
  
Our portfolio features some of the world’s leading events in sectors like ecommerce, healthcare, edtech, and fintech. We’re growing fast with an entrepreneurial culture that empowers big ideas and quick action, plus an ambitious acquisition strategy bringing exciting new events into our mix.
  
  
Alongside our market-leading events, we’re building tech and data-driven products that supercharge connections – from one-to-one meeting programs and curated table talks to year-round engagement platforms.
  
  
Whatever your role, you’ll join a global team redefining how industries connect, collaborate, and grow – working with some of the most talented people in the business.
  
  
Think that sounds good? Wait until our talent acquisition team tells you about the culture.
  
  
**A bit about you**  
  
First things first: whatever your background, beliefs or ambitions, there’s a culture of belonging at Hyve — and everyone is welcome. The question isn’t where you’ve come from, but where you want to go.
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you’re curious, collaborative and not afraid to challenge convention. We look for people who take pride in what they do, who are excited by change and always moving forward. The kind of people who stay open, keep learning, and look for better ways to make an impact.
  
  
Our shared behaviours guide how we work: we dare to do things differently, own our work, embrace collaboration, stay true to ourselves and others, and remember that optimism wins.
  
  
If that sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**About Bett**  
  
Bett is a dynamic and engaged online and live community that learns, trades and networks all year round. It is the world’s largest education technology event series and is the global meeting place for the education technology industry. With over 35 years of heritage, Bett provides a platform for innovation, dialogue, networking and global trade – bringing together exhibitors and visitors from around the world, physically and online, to buy, sell and make connections. The
  
  
Bett global series is comprised of four physical events, in four continents, and an extensive suite of online activities that span the year and the globe. Globally, we welcome over 60,000 educators to our events and over 1200 technology providers.
  
  
**About the role**  
  
As Marketing Executive for the EdTech portfolio, you will join our marketing team and work closely with the wider Bett team. Your role will be to drive the marketing campaigns across multiple platforms for our flagship show Bett UK.
  
  
You will also support on the portfolio’s 365 content-marketing campaign and onsite marketing delivery for key partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  

* Working with the Senior Marketing Manager and the rest of the Bett marketing team (there’s 4 of us), to support and deliver the marketing strategy and campaign plans for Bett UK and Bett Asia. You’ll ensure each activity is delivered within the deadline and gains the required audience reach across all audiences (visitors, delegates, sponsors and exhibitors).
* Work collaboratively with key internal teams: central marketing operations team for emails, website, paid media and data plus creative team for campaign messaging and assets, to ensure all channels and opportunities are effectively optimised.
* Execute the social media plan for Bett UK and Bett Asia ensuring content is created, scheduled, monitored and optimised across all platforms, leading to follower growth and increase in engagement (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok and YouTube).
* Create and update social media reports, analysing campaigns and adjusting frequently. Presenting the results to the team, gathering feedback and implementing changes.
* Support the delivery and execution of media partnerships, in print, digital and social to drive registration to the event.
* Lead on repurposing content for social media, creating different types of posts and engaging online with our community.
* Lead on influencer marketing campaigns.
* Work with the Accounts Payable team to raise PO’s and own the invoicing process for the marketing team.
* Direct the implementation of a wide range of content forms, including video, text, still imagery, animation, live action and other content forms that best utilize the technology available on any given social media/digital platform.

Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved.

We’re hiring our first marketer in London. Europe is our next growth market, and right now we’ve got a tight-knit, quota-focused sales team with big goals and not much regional marketing behind them—yet.

We’re starting in the UK with plans to expand across the region. You’ll work closely with our global events lead on moments where EMEA shows up inside the worldwide program, and with our growth team on campaigns that need European flair.

* Own the EMEA field calendar and the budget behind it — decide which events, dinners, and roadshows are worth doing, and which ones we skip

* Build our EMEA partner and channel motion — joint events, co-marketing, and the relationships that get us in front of buyers we can't reach on our own

jobs.description:
At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day.
  
  
Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company’s DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand.
  
  
Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world’s most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more.
  
  
We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers.
  
  
We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty.
  
  
**This role is a Hybrid Role:**
Employees are expected to work from our London office 3 days per week and may work remotely the remaining days.
  
  
**Overview**
A Brand Champion for the Revlon Professional and American Crew portfolio, responsible for driving omni-channel growth across salons, wholesalers (B2B), pro-retail and e-commerce B2C) in the UKI market. The role bridges global brand strategy with local commercial execution, owning trade activation, in-store excellence and 360° consumer campaigns to accelerate visibility, conversion and sell-out in a fast-scaling retail and B2C landscape.
  
  
**Omni-Channel Trade Activation & In-Store Execution:**
Design and deliver omni-channel trade activation plans across B2B and B2C customers, maximizing sell-out, loyalty and market share.
  
  

* Partner closely with Sales, Area Managers, Distributors and key customers to align brand priorities with promotional calendars and commercial objectives.
* Lead the development and execution of Point of Sale, Visual and Merchandising solutions, ensuring consistent, premium brand presence across direct and indirect customers.
* Brief and manage agencies to deliver clear, effective assets on time and within customer timelines.
* Track performance and ROI of trade activity, translating insights into optimization plans.

**Pro-Retail & E-Commerce Growth:**
Drive growth of pro-retail and e-commerce as strategic omni-channel levers for recruitment, visibility and conversion.
  
  

* Lead trade marketing and e-trade strategies with key partners (e.g. Boots, Tesco, Savers, e-tailers), spanning in-store and digital touchpoints.
* Own merchandising strategies including shelf layouts, planograms, permanent and promotional displays, and seasonal activations.
* Develop, localize and optimize PDP content (copy, visuals, claims, SEO) ensuring data accuracy and best-in-class execution across platforms.
* Monitor performance KPIs (traffic, conversion, rankings, sell-out) and recommend growth-driving actions.

**Brand Campaigns & NPD Execution:**
Lead 360° omni-channel campaigns driving end-consumer engagement and retailer conversion across in-store, Retailer.com, OOH and sampling.
  
  

* Act as project lead across Sales, Demand Planning, Digital Marketing, Education and agency partners.
* Own local NPD execution, including launch support, SKU transitions and planogram updates, ensuring strong sell-in readiness.
* Equip Sales teams with clear NPD updates and presentation materials to support commercial success. Management of trade, PR and press sampling

**Commercial & Operational Ownership:**
Full accountability for Brand Support / A&M budgets, including activity P&Ls, PO management and ROI tracking.
  
  

* Present clear overviews of activity plans, investment & performance to internal stakeholder & external customers.
* Leverage shopper, market and e-commerce insights to refine UKI omni-channel portfolio and GTM strategy.
* Manage vendor relationships, SAP process, product data, local stock forecasts to ensure operational excellence.

**Who You Are**

* Strong trade and operational marketing experience within Beauty or Professional Hair, across omni-channel environments.
* Proven delivery of in-store execution, e-trade content and integrated campaigns.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills; SAP and Salsify experience advantageous
* Confident communicator able to influence senior stakeholders, agencies and customers.
* Passion for professional hair and the stylist community, with curiosity for market trends.
